ac_present.title: Acceptance criteria
ac_present.missing: We could not find acceptance criteria.
ac_present.add:
You can copy this and adjust it to your case. Either format works. A short list under an "Acceptance criteria" heading, one result per line:

## Acceptance criteria
- The last cost is 0 after a movement with cost 0

Or Given / When / Then, each at the start of its line:

Given a product with last cost = 50
When I save a movement with cost = 0
Then the last cost is 0

Italian works too: "Criteri di accettazione", or Dato / Quando / Allora.
ac_present.question: What should be true when this is done? Plain sentences (at least 150 characters), or Given / When / Then.
ac_present.example: The last cost is 0 after a movement with cost 0. The KPI row for that product shows 0 as its last unit cost, and the previous value of 50 is not shown anymore.
ac_present.label: acceptance criteria (Given / When / Then, or a list under an Acceptance criteria heading), in customfield_11707 or the description

ac_testable.title: Acceptance criteria: results must be specific
ac_testable.missing: An acceptance criterion does not state a concrete result.
ac_testable.add:
Please avoid "it works" or "as expected". A number or the exact text is enough, for example:

- The last cost is 0
Then the message is "No data available with current filters"
ac_testable.question: An acceptance criterion is vague. Write it again with numbers or the exact text, at least 150 characters (or as Given / When / Then).
ac_testable.example: The last cost is 0 after a movement with cost 0, and the KPI row shows 0 as the last unit cost. The previous value of 50 does not appear anywhere for that product.
ac_testable.label: testable AC: each Then or AC item an observable assertion, not "works correctly"

steps.title: Steps to reproduce
steps.missing: There is no Steps to reproduce section (or user story).
steps.add:
A short numbered list is enough. You can adapt this:

## Steps to reproduce
1. Open the product
2. Save a movement with cost = 0
3. Check the last cost
steps.question: How do you reproduce it? One step per line.
steps.example:
Open the product
Save a movement with cost = 0
Check the last cost
steps.label: steps to reproduce (Bug) or a user story (Story)

expected_defined.title: Expected and actual result
expected_defined.missing: Expected and Actual are not both filled in.
expected_defined.add:
Please add both sections, for example:

## Expected
The last cost is 0

## Actual
The last cost is still 50
expected_defined.question: What should happen, and what happens now? Write: expected | actual
expected_defined.example: The last cost is 0 | The last cost is still 50
expected_defined.label: clear expected behaviour (Expected vs Actual, or AC present)

context.title: Summary
context.missing: There is no Summary or Context section.
context.add:
A couple of sentences is enough, for example:

## Summary
When cost is 0, last cost is not updated. The previous value is kept.
context.question: In one or two sentences, what is wrong?
context.example: When cost is 0, last cost is not updated. The previous value is kept.
context.label: a Context / Summary section

title_prefix.title: Title prefix
title_prefix.missing: The title does not start with [FE], [BE] or [FS].
title_prefix.add:
Please start the title with [BE] (backend), [FE] (frontend) or [FS] (both).
Example: [BE] last cost stays 50 when the movement cost is 0
title_prefix.question: Is this backend, frontend or both? Type BE, FE or FS.
title_prefix.label: title prefix [FE|BE|FS]

feature_label.title: Feature label
feature_label.missing: The ticket has no warehouse feature label.
feature_label.add:

Giacenza_Prodotti, Lista_Movimenti_Magazzino, Report_Magazzino, Importa_Giacenze,
arrivi_merce_magazzino, Il_mio_magazzino, Minimum_stock, Spinta_warehouse
feature_label.question: Which feature is it? One of: Lista_Movimenti_Magazzino, Report_Magazzino, Giacenza_Prodotti, Importa_Giacenze, arrivi_merce_magazzino, Il_mio_magazzino, Minimum_stock, Spinta_warehouse
feature_label.label: a warehouse feature label (e.g. Giacenza_Prodotti)

environment.title: Environment
environment.missing: There is no Environment section with Env: …
environment.add:
Please add which environment you used (prod, staging or local):

## Environment
Env: local
environment.question: Which environment did you use (prod, staging or local)?
environment.label: environment / workspace context

steps.title: User story
steps.missing: There is no User story line.
steps.add:
One line is enough. You can adapt this:

## User story
As a warehouse user, I want to filter the products stock by code so that I can find one product quickly.
steps.question: Who wants what, and why? One line.
steps.example: As a warehouse user, I want to filter the stock by code so that I find one product quickly.

context.title: Context
context.add:
Two or three sentences is enough, for example:

## Context
Finding one product in the stock list means scrolling the whole page. Filtering by code would save that.
context.question: In two or three sentences, why is this needed?
context.example: Finding one product in the stock list means scrolling the whole page.
